title: Grade 5 7.08
description: Learning Outcomes for Grade 5: Identify common 3D objects | Understand 3D objects | Identify properties of 3D objects | Describe 3D objects using faces | Describe 3D objects using vertices | Describe 3D objects using edges | Describe properties of cones | Describe properties of cylinders | Compare 3D objects | Recognise 3D objects in real life | Identify real-world 3D objects | Apply knowledge of 3D objects in context

questions.question: Which shape is a 3D object?
questions.solution: Use the key clue in the question and apply the lesson method step by step. This leads to Cube; Square; Triangle.

questions.question: How many dimensions does a 3D object have?
questions.solution: Count each object once, then match that total to the choices. The total count is 3; 2; 1.
